prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED WARM BROWN flat color field — think #6B5548, a
confident rocky chocolate-brown with a slight warm earth undertone,
the color of a board-game "mountain/stone" tile. Clearly BROWN, not
neutral-grey, not black, not slate. Visibly distinct from the tan
wastes tile (darker, browner, richer) and from the ocean tile
(warm, not cool). Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with
this one warm-brown color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper
border, NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO visible rock
features. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same
brown hue. A region-fill swatch, not a tile with a shape drawn on it.
formatted_prompt: Saturated flat warm-brown game-map terrain tile, editorial ink illustration register, vivid board-game cartogram aesthetic. The entire 1024x1024 frame filled edge-to-edge, corner-to-corner with one confident chocolate-brown color field — rich rocky brown #6B5548, warm earth undertone, darker and browner than ochre wastes, distinctly warm against cool ocean blue. Uniform saturated hue wall-to-wall with only the faintest brushstroke paint-texture variation within the same warm-brown tone. No hex outline, no border, no vignette, no rock features, no centered subject, no horizon. Pure region-fill swatch in punchy saturated brown, like a Settlers of Catan mountain tile rendered in confident ink-wash.
